decision.observation: The BIG LUGGAGE case is open with a ROPE CANNON labelled 'E pick up' near the front, plus a green canister lying to the right. Palms, dry grass and a campfire with blue wreckage at left; a distant mountain is the route ahead.
decision.hypothesis: Luggage holds climbing gear; the rope cannon is the single most useful item here. Grabbing it first, then the green canister, builds a loadout before the climb. Objective is now clear: climb to the mountain summit.
decision.memory: Island run started on PEAK difficulty. Goal: climb the mountain to the summit. Climbing needs EMPTY hands: hold J (left click) at a wall and steer with WASD; Shift = lunge/sprint. Stamina, hunger and weight all shrink the stamina bar. Crash site always spawns a backpack, flare, lantern and bugle — grab the backpack and flare.
